requirements: Free account required: unique username, email, password, 'I'm not a robot' captcha, accept T&C
Email verification required to activate the account before bookmarking
This is a general social bookmarking service — 'submission' means bookmarking a URL, not an editorial listing
preparation: An email address for account verification
The product URL to bookmark, plus tags/keywords
A real browser — the site sits behind Cloudflare and returns 403 to plain fetches
workflow: Register at https://www.folkd.com/register (username, email, password, captcha, accept terms)
Click the verification link in the activation email
Log in and bookmark the product URL — the legacy route pattern is folkd.com/submit/<target-url>
Add title, description, and tags so the bookmark is discoverable in Folkd's social search
watchFor: Cloudflare bot-check blocks automated fetches (403) — browser automation needs to pass the challenge
Legacy bookmarking site since 2006; value is a cheap profile/bookmark link, not launch traffic
Don't spam multiple bookmarks — social bookmarking sites ban accounts for self-promotion patterns
©2023 footer suggests the site is maintained but low-velocity
